name: Council of AI — verify_inclusion
description: Check a sha256 against the live public-root merkle via GET /api/proof?sha=. Three states only: VALID (included), INVALID (not a leaf), UNCHECKABLE (proof endpoint unreachable). Does not claim Ed25519 unless sig_ed25519 is present and checked separately. Never a grade.
